package noder
import("fmt";"encoding/binary";"os";"strings";"testing";"go-backend-ssa/internal/cmd/obj";"go-backend-ssa/internal/cmd/sys";"go-backend-ssa/internal/ir";"go-backend-ssa/internal/typecheck";"go-backend-ssa/internal/types";"go-backend-ssa/internal/types2";"go-backend-ssa/internal/syntax")
func TestSyncgoBodyFixture(t *testing.T){
 arch:=strings.SplitN(os.Getenv("SYNCGO_TARGET"),"-",2)[0];size:=8;var order binary.ByteOrder=binary.LittleEndian;frames:=0;if strings.HasSuffix(os.Getenv("SYNCGO_TARGET"),"-nosync"){frames=-1};switch arch{case "386","arm","mipsle":size=4;case "mips":size=4;order=binary.BigEndian;case "mips64","ppc64","s390x":order=binary.BigEndian}
 link:=&obj.Link{Pathname:"/src",Arch:&obj.LinkArch{Arch:&sys.Arch{Name:arch,PtrSize:size,RegSize:size,ByteOrder:order}}};u:=types.NewUniverseWithPositions(size,size,1<<50,&link.PosTable);u.LocalPkg=u.NewPkg("example/p","p");g:=ir.NewContext(u,link);tc:=typecheck.NewContext(g);tc.InitUniverse();g.Base.Flag.Lang="go1.27";g.Base.Flag.Complete=true;g.Debug.SyncFrames=frames;g.Debug.RangeFuncCheck=1
 c,err:=NewContext(types2.NewContext(),tc);if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 source:=`package p
var Counter int
var Sink any
var Global []int
func effect(n int)int{Counter++;return n}
func pair(n int)(int,int){return n,n+1}
func Eval(a []int,m map[int]int)int{a[effect(0)],m[effect(1)]=pair(effect(2));return effect(a[0])+effect(m[1])}
func CompareStrings(a,b string)bool{return a==b}
func CompareSmall(a,b struct{A int;B string;C any})bool{return a==b}
func CompareLarge(a,b [64]byte)bool{return a==b}
func Grow(n int)[]int{var s []int;for i:=0;i<n;i++{s=append(s,i)};return s}
func Capacity(n int)([]int,int){var s []int;for i:=0;i<n;i++{s=append(s,i)};return s,cap(s)}
func Map(m map[string]int,k string)(int,bool){m[k]++;v,ok:=m[k];delete(m,k);return v,ok}
func MapFat(m map[[128]byte][2048]byte,k [128]byte)[2048]byte{return m[k]}
func MapFloat(m map[float64]int,k float64){m[k]=m[k]+1}
func MakeMap(n int)map[string]int{return make(map[string]int,n)}
func MakeSlice(n int)[]int{s:=make([]int,n);copy(s,[]int{1,2});return append(s,3)}
func String(s string)([]byte,[]rune,string){b:=[]byte(s);r:=[]rune(s);return b,r,string(b)}
func RangeString(s string)int{n:=0;for i,r:=range s{n+=i+int(r)};return n}
func RangeMap(m map[int]int)int{n:=0;for k,v:=range m{n+=k+v};return n}
func RangeArray(a [4]int)int{n:=0;for _,v:=range a{n+=v};return n}
func RangeInt(n int)int{r:=0;for i:=range n{r+=i};return r}
func Channel(c chan int)(int,bool){select{case c<-1:return 1,true;case x,ok:=<-c:return x,ok;default:return 0,false}}
func ChanRange(c chan int)int{n:=0;for x:=range c{n+=x};return n}
func Deferred(f func(int),n int){defer f(n);go f(n+1)}
func Closure(n int)func()int{return func()int{n++;return n}}
func Literal()any{return "constant"}
func Nil()*int{return nil}
func Assert(x any)(int,bool){v,ok:=x.(int);return v,ok}
func SwitchInt(n int)int{switch n{case 0:return 4;case 1:return 2;case 2:return 9;case 3:return 7;case 4:return 1;case 5:return 8;case 6:return 3;case 7:return 6};return 0}
func SwitchString(s string)int{switch s{case "apple":return 1;case "pear":return 2;case "banana":return 3;case "plum":return 4;case "a":return 5;case "b":return 6};return 0}
type I interface{M()int}
type Number int
func(n Number)M()int{return int(n)}
func SwitchType(x any)int{switch v:=x.(type){case int:return v;case string:return len(v);case I:return v.M();case nil:return -1};return 0}
func Method(n Number)func()int{return n.M}
func Iface(n Number)I{return n}
func Generic[T comparable](m map[T]int,k T)int{return m[k]}
func Instance(m map[string]int,k string)int{return Generic(m,k)}
func Shape[T any](v T)any{return v}
func ShapeInstance(n int)any{return Shape(n)}
func Float(a,b float64)(float64,int64){return a/b,int64(a)}
func Division(a,b int)int{return a/b}
func Panic(v any){panic(v)}
func Phi(n,x int)int{a:=0;if n>0{a=x+1}else{a=x-1};for i:=0;i<n;i++{a=a*3+i};return a}
func Bound(s []byte,i uint64)byte{return s[i]}
func MinMax(a,b float64)float64{return min(a,b)+max(b,a)}
func Conversions(x float64,y uint64)(uint64,uint32,float64){return uint64(x),uint32(x),float64(y)}
func PointerStore(dst **int,p *int){*dst=p}
func SmallScan(p *int)*struct{P *int}{return &struct{P *int}{p}}
func SmallNoScan(x int)*struct{A,B,C int}{return &struct{A,B,C int}{x,x+1,x+2}}
func OpenDefer(n int)(v int){defer func(){v+=n}();return n*2}
func StackDefer(f func()){for i:=0;i<2;i++{defer f()}}
func PanicRecover()(v any){defer func(){v=recover()}();panic(1)}
func DynamicCall(f func(int)int,x int)int{return f(x)}
func InterfaceCall(i I)int{return i.M()}

`
 if strings.Contains(os.Getenv("SYNCGO_TARGET"),"largephi"){source+="\nfunc LargePhi(x int)int {n:=x;";for i:=0;i<260;i++{source+=fmt.Sprintf("if x & %d != 0 {n += %d}else{n -= %d};",1<<uint(i%12),i+1,i+1)};source+="return n}\n"}
 file,err:=syntax.Parse(syntax.NewFileBase("input.go"),strings.NewReader(source),nil,nil,syntax.CheckBranches);if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 info:=&types2.Info{StoreTypesInSyntax:true,Defs:map[*syntax.Name]types2.Object{},Uses:map[*syntax.Name]types2.Object{},Selections:map[*syntax.SelectorExpr]*types2.Selection{},Implicits:map[syntax.Node]types2.Object{},Scopes:map[syntax.Node]*types2.Scope{},Instances:map[*syntax.Name]types2.Instance{},FileVersions:map[*syntax.PosBase]string{}}
 conf:=types2.Config{Context:c.Checker,GoVersion:"go1.27",Sizes:c.Checker.SizesFor("gc",arch)};files:=[]*syntax.File{file};pkg,err:=conf.Check("example/p",files,info);if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 closures,err:=c.RewriteRangeFuncs(pkg,info,files);if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)};data,err:=c.WritePackage(pkg,info,files,closures);if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 if err:=os.WriteFile(BODY_INPUT_PATH,[]byte(data),0600);err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
}
